overview: Showroom and vehicle twins that plug straight into the sales process — letting buyers explore inventory and configurations spatially, anchored by the BMW Lafayette proof point.

project.name: BMW Lafayette — Dealership & Vehicle Twins

evidence.Case Studies: BMW Lafayette — dealership twin plus X1 / X5 / X7 vehicle twins used as an automotive-retail proof point.
evidence.Client Feedback: “Buyers walk the floor before they ever visit.”
evidence.Press & Research: Automotive is one of four dominant commercial twin verticals through 2030.
